prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE transparent raster SHIELD power-up pickup icon for the anime bullet-hell game Refrain. The item absorbs an enemy hit to protect the player's core. It will appear as a small falling pickup and a small HUD inventory icon.
Input image: STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Match the attached life item's clean bold charcoal outline, chunky readable silhouette, cel-shaded anime-game highlights, and polished collectible-item finish. Do NOT reproduce its heart shape, cross, or green color. Create a NEW shield illustration.
Subject: one compact upright futuristic LIGHT SHIELD, front-facing and symmetrical. Broad upper shoulders, gently convex top, tapering sides and a definite pointed bottom. A strong pale silver-white protective shield face with a thick polished silver rim and continuous dark charcoal outer contour. In the center, one large luminous icy-cyan DIAMOND CORE inset in a simple silver diamond bezel. A few broad cyan-tinted glass/enamel facets radiate into the shield face, conveying an energy barrier protecting the core. Use only a few large clear color regions so the shield and diamond remain recognizable at 25 to 40 pixels tall. Silver and white are the dominant colors; icy cyan is a restrained secondary accent. The central core must be solid and opaque, not a cutout. Bright upper-left highlight, simple charcoal lower-right shading, attractive 2D anime game item illustration, not a photo and not pixel art.
Composition: one shield centered on a square 1024x1024 canvas, total silhouette fills about 86% canvas height and 76% width, all tips and edges inside frame, balanced margins. Front view, no perspective tilt, no handle. No circular bubble around it, no pedestal, no environment, no scattered particles. No rivets, no medieval heraldry, no wings, no swords, no heart symbol, no plus sign, no text or letters. Do not render an enemy shield or a broken shield.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha PNG with perfectly transparent outer corners. Shield itself is opaque. Keep highlights inside its silhouette, no exterior glow or cast shadow. No background or checkerboard graphic, no enclosing square, no border around the image, no watermark. Production-ready standalone game sprite.
